unbounded_runtime: encoding/json.Decoder internal buffers after Working() of the document
encoding/xml.Decoder token scratch and Decode reflection into caller structs after Working() of the document
locktoml node.value() map rebuild after per-token/table charges; json.Marshal record conversion is charged as Working of the JSON bytes
RPM page buffers in core/rpm.snapshot.at allocate against MaxReadBytes, not MaxResultBytes; package DTOs are charged in emit before append
32KiB snapshot read scratch in pipeline materials.Open after Once of the file size
apk bufio.Scanner.Text line copies; DPKG MIME header maps after readBlock charges
analyzer.MergePackages has no context and is a test/benchmark exact-identity adapter only; ScanReport merge is handlerParsedBudget
Go map growth beyond conservative SizeMap/SizePtr charges

strict_preallocation_status: Shared MaxResultBytes and MaxExpressionNodes are charged before working copies, syntax nodes, enqueue, merge inserts, and report appends. Cached snapshot bytes and POM analysis results are Once-charged. Remaining decoder internals, RPM page buffers, and sort temporaries are named in result_memory.unbounded_runtime.
